G571.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and πιστός; (actively) disbelieving, i.e. without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing):--that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever(-ing).

G796.d: from ἀστράπτω; lightning; by analogy, glare:--lightning, bright shining.

G593.d: from ἀπό and δοκιμάζω; to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate:--disallow, reject.

G747.d: from ἀρχή and ἄγω; a chief leader:--author, captain, prince.

G515.d: from ἄξιος; to deem entitled or fit:--desire, think good, count (think) worthy.

G671.d: from a compound of ἀπό and χράομαι; the act of using up, i.e. consumption:--using.

G892.d: perhaps remotely from (to shed forth); chaff (as diffusive):--chaff.

G568.d: from ἀπό and ἔχω; (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively):--be, have, receive.

G787.d: of Latin origin; an assarius or as, a Roman coin:--farthing.

G927.d: from βαρύς and τιμή; highly valuable:--very precious.

G626.d: middle voice from a compound of ἀπό and λόγος; to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, i.e. exculpate (self):--answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self.

G739.d: from ἄρτι; fresh, i.e. (by implication) complete:--perfect.

G583.d: from ἀπό and γράφω; to write off (a copy or list), i.e. enrol:--tax, write.

G952.d: from the base of βάσις and (a threshold); accessible (as by crossing the door-way), i.e. (by implication, of Jewish notions) heathenish, wicked:--profane (person).

G955.d: of Hebrew origin (בְּלִיַּעַל); worthlessness; Belial, as an epithet of Satan:--Belial.

G573.d: probably from Α (as a particle of union) and the base of πλέκω; properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear):--single.

G800.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and σύμφωνος; inharmonious (figuratively):--agree not.

G712.d: apparently neuter of a superlative from the same as ἄῤῥην; the best meal (or breakfast; perhaps from ("early")), i.e. luncheon:--dinner.

G560.d: from ἀπό and ἐλπίζω; to hope out, i.e. fully expect:--hope for again.

G590.d: from ἀπό and δῆμος; absent from one's own people, i.e. a foreign traveller:--taking a far journey.

G676.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of πρός and (to go); inaccessible:--which no man can approach.

G541.d: from a compound of ἀπό and αὐγάζω; an off-flash, i.e. effulgence:--brightness.

G537.d: from Α (as a particle of union) and πᾶς; absolutely all or (singular) every one:--all (things), every (one), whole.

G971.d: from βία; to force, i.e. (reflexively) to crowd oneself (into), or (passively) to be seized:--press, suffer violence.

G660.d: from ἀπό and (to jostle); to brush off:--shake off.

G863.d: from ἀπό and (to send; an intensive form of , to go); to send forth, in various applications (as follow):--cry, forgive, forsake, lay aside, leave, let (alone, be, go, have), omit, put (send) away, remit, suffer, yield up.

G749.d: from ἀρχή and ἱερεύς; the high-priest (literally, of the Jews, typically, Christ); by extension a chief priest:--chief (high) priest, chief of the priests.

G890.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and χρηστός; inefficient, i.e. (by implication) detrimental:--unprofitable.

G788.d: neuter comparative of the base of ἐγγύς; more nearly, i.e. very near:--close.

G578.d: from ἀπό and βλέπω; to look away from everything else, i.e. (figuratively) intently regard:--have respect.

G976.d: properly, the inner bark of the papyrus plant, i.e. (by implication) a sheet or scroll of writing:--book.

G505.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποκρίνομαι; undissembled, i.e. sincere:--without dissimulation (hypocrisy), unfeigned.

G765.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σέβομαι; irreverent, i.e. (by extension) impious or wicked:-- ungodly (man).

G931.d: perhaps remotely from the same as βάσις (through the notion of going to the bottom); a touch-stone, i.e. (by analogy) torture:--torment.

G682.d: probably of foreign origin; Apphia, a woman of Collosæ:--Apphia.

G995.d: from βοάω; a halloo, i.e. call (for aid, etc.):--cry.

G782.d: from Α (as a particle of union) and a presumed form of σπάω; to enfold in the arms, i.e. (by implication) to salute, (figuratively) to welcome:--embrace, greet, salute, take leave.

G511.d: comparative degree of ἄνω; upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book:--above, higher.

G992.d: from βάλλω; fit to be cast (i.e. applied):--must be put.

G600.d: from ἀπό and καθίστημι; to reconstitute (in health, home or organization):--restore (again).

G674.d: from ἀπό and ψύχω; to breathe out, i.e. faint:--hearts failing.

G750.d: from ἀρχή and ποιμήν; a head shepherd:--chief shepherd.

G824.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and τόπος; out of place, i.e. (figuratively) improper, injurious, wicked:--amiss, harm, unreasonable.

G632.d: from ἀπό and the base of νόμος; to apportion, i.e. bestow:--give.

G534.d: from ἀπό and ἄρτι; from now, i.e. henceforth (already):--from henceforth.

G663.d: from the base of ἀποτόμως; (figuratively) decisiveness, i.e. rigor:--severity.

G715.d: probably from ἀρκέω; a bear (as obstructing by ferocity):--bear.

G766.d: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed (of uncertain derivation, but apparently meaning continent); licentiousness (sometimes including other vices):--filthy, lasciviousness, wantonness.

G655.d: from ἀπό and the base of στυγνητός; to detest utterly:--abhor.

G760.d: of Hebrew origin (אָסָא); Asa, an Israelite:--Asa.

G504.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὕδωρ; waterless, i.e. dry:--dry, without water.

G912.d: of Chaldee origin (גָּאוֹן and אֲבַגְתָא); son of Abba; Bar-abbas, an Israelite:--Barabbas.

G698.d: from Ἄρειος Πάγος; an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill:--Areopagite.

G610.d: from ἀποκρίνομαι (in its original sense of judging); a judicial decision:--sentence.

G870.d: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φόβος; fearlessly:--without fear.

G820.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and τιμή; (negatively) unhonoured or (positively) dishonoured:--despised, without honour, less honourable (comparative degree).

G740.d: from αἴρω; bread (as raised) or a loaf:--(shew-)bread, loaf.

G873.d: from ἀπό and ὁρίζω; to set off by boundary, i.e. (figuratively) limit, exclude, appoint, etc.:--divide, separate, sever.

G841.d: from αὐτάρκης; self-satisfaction, i.e. (abstractly) contentedness, or (concretely) a competence:--contentment, sufficiency.

G609.d: from ἀπό and κόπτω; to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts):--cut off. Compare κατατομή.

G810.d: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σώζω; properly, unsavedness, i.e. (by implication) profligacy:--excess, riot.

G574.d: adverb from ἁπλοῦς (in the objective sense of ἁπλότης); bountifully; --liberally.

G551.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of πειράω; untried, i.e. not temptable:--not to be tempted.

G936.d: from βασιλεύς; to rule (literally or figuratively):--king, reign.

G948.d: from a (presumed) derivative of (to stink); to be disgusted, i.e. (by implication) detest (especially of idolatry):--abhor, abominable.

G744.d: from ἀρχή; original or primeval:--(them of) old (time).

G677.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of προσκόπτω; actively, inoffensive, i.e. not leading into sin; passively, faultless, i.e. not led into sin:--none (void of, without) offence.

G582.d: from ἀπογράφω; an enrollment; by implication, an assessment:--taxing.

G866.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and φιλάργυρος; unavaricious:--without covetousness, not greedy of filthy lucre.

G762.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σβέννυμι; not extinguished, i.e. (by implication) perpetual:--not to be quenched, unquenchable.

G763.d: from ἀσεβής; impiety, i.e. (by implication) wickedness:--ungodly(-liness).

G642.d: from ἀπό and a derivative of ὀρφανός; to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse):--take.

G803.d: from ἀσφαλής; security (literally or figuratively):--certainty, safety.

G998.d: from βοή and theo (to run); a succorer:--helper.

G981.d: from βιόω; living (properly, the act, by implication, the mode):--manner of life.

G638.d: from ἀπό and πνίγω; to stifle (by drowning or overgrowth):--choke.

G825.d: from (a king of Pergamus); Attaleia, a place in Pamphylia:--Attalia.

G670.d: from ἀπό and the middle voice of φορτίζω; to unload:--unlade.

G508.d: from ἄνω and γῆ; above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story:--upper room.

G509.d: from ἄνω; from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew:--from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top.

G827.d: of uncertain derivation; a ray of light, i.e. (by implication) radiance, dawn:--break of day.

G860.d: from ἅπτομαι; probably a ligament (as fastening):--joint.

G602.d: from ἀποκαλύπτω; disclosure:--appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation.

G598.d: from ἀπό and θλίβω; to crowd (from every side):--press.

G872.d: from ἀπό and ὁράω; to consider attentively:--look.

G707.d: of Hebrew origin (רָמָה); Arimathæa (or Ramah), a place in Palestine:--Arimathæa.

G501.d: from (the hold of a ship); to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.):--draw (out).

G830.d: from αὐτός and the same as αἱρετίζω; self-chosen, i.e. (by implication) voluntary:--of own accord, willing of self.

G517.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὁρατός; invisible:--invisible (thing).

G557.d: from a compound of ἀπό and ἐλέγχω; refutation, i.e. (by implication) contempt:--nought.

G625.d: probably from the same as Ἀπολλωνία; Apollos, an Israelite:--Apollos.

G928.d: from βάσανος; to torture:--pain, toil, torment, toss, vex.

G611.d: from ἀπό and ; to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare עָנָה) to begin to speak (where an address is expected):--answer.

G937.d: from βασιλεύς; regal (in relation), i.e. (literally) belonging to (or befitting) the sovereign (as land, dress, or a courtier), or (figuratively) preeminent:--king's, nobleman, royal.

G733.d: from ἄῤῥην and κοίτη; a sodomite:--abuser of (that defile) self with mankind.

G657.d: middle voice from ἀπό and τάσσω; literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce:--bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away.

G619.d: from a comparative of ἀπό and (to enjoy); full enjoyment:--enjoy(-ment).

G924.d: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and טָמֵא); son of Timæus (or the unclean); Bar-timæus, an Israelite:--Bartimæus.

G907.d: from a derivative of βάπτω; to immerse, submerge; to make whelmed (i.e. fully wet); used only (in the New Testament) of ceremonial ablution, especially (technically) of the ordinance of Christian baptism:--Baptist, baptize, wash.

G691.d: from ἀργός; to be idle, i.e. (figuratively) to delay:--linger.

G714.d: apparently a primary verb (but probably akin to αἴρω through the idea of raising a barrier); properly, to ward off, i.e. (by implication) to avail (figuratively, be satisfactory):--be content, be enough, suffice, be sufficient.

G700.d: probably from αἴρω (through the idea of exciting emotion); to be agreeable (or by implication, to seek to be so):--please.

G853.d: from ἀφανής; to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed):-- corrupt, disfigure, perish, vanish away.

G769.d: from ἀσθενής; feebleness (of mind or body); by implication, malady; morally, frailty:--disease, infirmity, sickness, weakness.

G865.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and φιλάγαθος; hostile to virtue:--despiser of those that are good.
r: despisers of those that are good

G729.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as ῥαφίς; unsewed, i.e. of a single piece:--without seam.

G888.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of χρή (compare χρεία); useless, i.e. (euphemistically) unmeritorious:--unprofitable.

G914.d: of Hebrew origin (בֶּרֶכְיָה); Barachias (i.e. Berechijah), an Israelite:--Barachias.

G832.d: from αὐλός; to play the flute:--pipe.

G880.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and φωνή; voiceless, i.e. mute (by nature or choice); figuratively, unmeaning:--dumb, without signification.

G932.d: from βασιλεύς; properly, royalty, i.e. (abstractly) rule, or (concretely) a realm (literally or figuratively):--kingdom, + reign.

G503.d: from a compound of ἀντί and ὀφθαλμός; to face:--bear up into.

G658.d: from ἀπό and τελέω; to complete entirely, i.e. consummate:--finish.

G921.d: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and נְבִיא); son of Nabas (i.e. prophecy); Barnabas, an Israelite:--Barnabas.

G997.d: from βοηθός; to aid or relieve:--help, succor.

G695.d: from ἄργυρος and κόπτω; a beater (i.e. worker) of silver:--silversmith.

G861.d: from ἄφθαρτος; incorruptibility; genitive, unending existence; (figuratively) genuineness:--immortality, incorruption, sincerity.

G954.d: of Chaldee origin (by parody on בַּעַל זְבוּב); dung-god; Beelzebul, a name of Satan:--Beelzebub.

G773.d: of uncertain derivation; Asia, i.e. Asia Minor, or (usually) only its western shore:--Asia.

G654.d: from ἀπό and στρέφω; to turn away or back (literally or figuratively):--bring again, pervert, turn away (from).

G645.d: from ἀπό and σπάω; to drag forth, i.e. (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously):--(with-)draw (away), after we were gotten from.

G526.d: from ἀπό and a derivative of ἀλλότριος; to estrange away, i.e. (passively and figuratively) to be non-participant:-- alienate, be alien.

G923.d: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and probably צְבָא); son of Sabas (or Tsaba); Bar-sabas, the name of two Israelites:--Barsabas.

G802.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of συντίθεμαι; properly, not agreed, i.e. treacherous to compacts:-- covenant-breaker.

G711.d: from the same as ἄριστον and βουλή; best counselling; Aristoboulus, a Christian:--Aristobulus.

G735.d: probably from the same as ἀρτέμων; prompt; Artemis, the name of a Grecian goddess borrowed by the Asiatics for one of their deities:--Diana.

G743.d: from ἄρχω and ἄγγελος; a chief angel:--archangel.

G500.d: from ἀντί and Χριστός; an opponent of the Messiah:--antichrist.

G850.d: from (probably from a base akin to that of ἀήρ) (dust, as dried by wind); properly, dirty, i.e. (by implication) obscure:--dark.

G966.d: of Chaldee origin (compare בַּיִת and צַיָּד); fishing-house; Bethsaida, a place in Palestine:--Bethsaida.

G562.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of πέραν; unfinished, i.e. (by implication) interminable:--endless.

G736.d: from a derivative of ἄρτι; properly, something ready (or else more remotely from αἴρω (compare ἄρτος); something hung up), i.e. (specially) the topsail (rather foresail or jib) of a vessel:--mainsail.

G734.d: contracted from a compound of Ἄρτεμις and δῶρον; gift of Artemis; Artemas (or Artemidorus), a Christian:--Artemas.

G648.d: from ἀπό and a derivative of στέγη; to unroof:--uncover.

G748.d: from ἀρχή and a derivative of ἱερός; high-priestly:--of the high-priest.

G946.d: from βδελύσσω; a detestation, i.e. (specially) idolatry:--abomination.

G757.d: a primary verb; to be first (in political rank or power):--reign (rule) over.

G659.d: from ἀπό and τίθημι; to put away (literally or figuratively):--cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off).

G759.d: from αἴρω (in the sense of sending off scent); an aromatic:--(sweet) spice.

G896.d: of Hebrew origin (בַּעַל); Baal, a Phœnician deity (used as a symbol of idolatry):--Baal.

G988.d: from βλάσφημος; vilification (especially against God):--blasphemy, evil speaking, railing.

G589.d: from ἀπόδημος; to go abroad, i.e. visit a foreign land:--go (travel) into a far country, journey.

G994.d: apparently a prolonged form of a primary verb; to halloo, i.e. shout (for help or in a tumultuous way):--cry.

G753.d: from ἀρχή and τέκτων; a chief constructor, i.e. "architect":--masterbuilder.

G512.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of ὠφέλιμος; useless or (neuter) inutility:--unprofitable(-ness).

G637.d: from ἀπό and πλύνω; to rinse off:--wash.

G701.d: from ἀρέσκω; agreeable; by implication, fit:--(things that) please(-ing), reason.

G895.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and ψυχή; lifeless, i.e. inanimate (mechanical):--without life.

G777.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and σῖτος; without (taking) food:--fasting.

G864.d: from ἀπό and the base of ἱκανός; to go (i.e. spread) forth (by rumor):--come abroad.

G669.d: from ἀπό and φθέγγομαι; to enunciate plainly, i.e. declare:--say, speak forth, utterance.

G565.d: from ἀπό and ἔρχομαι; to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively:--come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, … ways), pass away, be past.

G622.d: from ἀπό and the base of ὄλεθρος; to destroy fully (reflexively, to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively:--destroy, die, lose, mar, perish.

G878.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and φρήν; properly, mindless, i.e. stupid, (by implication) ignorant, (specially) egotistic, (practically) rash, or (morally) unbelieving:--fool(-ish), unwise.

G639.d: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and the base of πορεύομαι; to have no way out, i.e. be at a loss (mentally):-- (stand in) doubt, be perplexed.

G823.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of τομώτερος; uncut, i.e. (by implication) indivisible (an "atom" of time):-- moment.

G903.d: of Hebrew origin (בִּלְעָם); Balaam, a Mesopotamian (symbolic of a false teacher):--Balaam.

G702.d: of foreign origin; Aretas, an Arabian:--Aretas.

G690.d: from Ἀραβία; an Arab or native of Arabia:--Arabian.

G918.d: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and תַּלְמַי); son of Tolmai; Bar-tholomæus, a Christian apostle:--Bartholomeus.

G528.d: from ἀπό and a derivative of ἀντί; to meet away, i.e. encounter:--meet.

G770.d: from ἀσθενής; to be feeble (in any sense):--be diseased, impotent folk (man), (be) sick, (be, be made) weak.

G724.d: from ἁρπάζω; pillage (properly abstract):--extortion, ravening, spoiling.

G783.d: from ἀσπάζομαι; a greeting (in person or by letter):--greeting, salutation.

G689.d: of Hebrew origin (רָם); Aram (i.e. Ram), an Israelite:--Aram.

G616.d: from ἀπό and the base of κῦμα; to breed forth, i.e. (by transference) to generate (figuratively):--beget, produce.

G599.d: from ἀπό and θνήσκω; to die off (literally or figuratively):--be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).

G867.d: from ἀφικνέομαι; properly, arrival, i.e. (by implication) departure:--departing.

G801.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and συνετός; unintelligent; by implication, wicked:--foolish, without understanding.

G683.d: from ἀπό and the middle voice of or (to shove); to push off, figuratively, to reject:--cast away, put away (from), thrust away (from).

G506.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποτάσσω; unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper):--disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.

G572.d: from ἁπλοῦς; singleness, i.e. (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self-seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal):--bountifulness, liberal(-ity), simplicity, singleness.

G884.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of χαρίζομαι; thankless, i.e. ungrateful:--unthankful.

G507.d: adverb from ἀντί; upward or on the top:--above, brim, high, up.

G710.d: apparently a comparative of the same as ἄριστον; the left hand (as second-best):--left (hand).

G662.d: from ἀπό and τολμάω; to venture plainly:--be very bold.

G939.d: from (to walk); a pace ("base"), i.e. (by implication) the foot:--foot.

G822.d: from the same as ἀήρ; mist:--vapour.

G614.d: from ἀποκρύπτω; secret; by implication, treasured:--hid, kept secret.

G684.d: from a presumed derivative of ἀπόλλυμι; ruin or loss (physical, spiritual or eternal):--damnable(-nation), destruction, die, perdition, X perish, pernicious ways, waste.

G530.d: probably from ἅπας; one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively):--once.

G963.d: of Chaldee origin; date-house; Beth-any, a place in Palestine:--Bethany.

G536.d: from a compound of ἀπό and ἄρχομαι; a beginning of sacrifice, i.e. the (Jewish) first-fruit (figuratively):--first-fruits.

G686.d: probably from αἴρω (through the idea of drawing a conclusion); a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows):--haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore. Often used in connection with other particles, especially γέ or οὖν (after) or εἰ (before). Compare also ἆρα.

G586.d: from ἀπό and δεκατόω; to tithe (as debtor or creditor):--(give, pay, take) tithe.

G842.d: from αὐτός and ἀρκέω; self-complacent, i.e. contented:--content.

G761.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σαλεύω; unshaken, i.e. (by implication) immovable (figuratively):--which cannot be moved, unmovable.

G597.d: from ἀπό and θησαυρίζω; to treasure away:--lay up in store.

G728.d: of Hebrew origin (עֲרָבוֹן); a pledge, i.e. part of the purchase-money or property given in advance as security for the rest:--earnest.

G941.d: perhaps remotely derived from the base of βάσις (through the idea of removal); to lift, literally or figuratively (endure, declare, sustain, receive, etc.):--bear, carry, take up.

G720.d: perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and the middle voice of ῥέω; to contradict, i.e. disavow, reject, abnegate:--deny, refuse.

G808.d: from ἀσχήμων; an indecency; by implication, the pudenda:--shame, that which is unseemly.

G848.d: contracted for ἑαυτοῦ; self (in some oblique case or reflexive relation):--her (own), (of) him(-self), his (own), of it, thee, their (own), them(-selves), they.

G685.d: probably from αἴρω; properly, prayer (as lifted to Heaven), i.e. (by implication) imprecation:--curse.

G755.d: from ἀρχή and a compound of τρεῖς and κλίνω (a dinner-bed, because composed of three couches); director of the entertainment:--governor (ruler) of the feast.

G819.d: from ἄτιμος; infamy, i.e. (subjectively) comparative indignity, (objectively) disgrace:--dishonour, reproach, shame, vile.

G919.d: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and יְהוֹשׁוּעַ); son of Jesus (or Joshua); Bar-jesus, an Israelite:--Barjesus.

G775.d: from Ἀσία and ἀρχή; an Asiarch or president of the public festivities in a city of Asia Minor:--chief of Asia.

G535.d: from a derivative of ἀπάρτι; completion:--finishing.

G772.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of σθενόω; strengthless (in various applications, literal, figurative and moral):--more feeble, impotent, sick, without strength, weak(-er, -ness, thing).

G554.d: middle voice from ἀπό and ἐκδύω; to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil:--put off, spoil.
r: seeing that ye have put off

G620.d: from ἀπό and λείπω; to leave behind (passively, remain); by implication, to forsake:--leave, remain.

G804.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and sphallo (to "fail"); secure (literally or figuratively):--certain(-ty), safe, sure.

G920.d: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and יוֹנָה); son of Jonas (or Jonah); Bar-jonas, an Israelite:--Bar-jona.

G913.d: of Hebrew origin (בָּרָק); Barak, an Israelite:--Barak.

G901.d: from the base of βάσις; profound (as going down), literally or figuratively:--deep, very early.

G681.d: a primary verb; properly, to fasten to, i.e. (specially) to set on fire:--kindle, light.

G821.d: from ἄτιμος; used like ἀτιμάζω, to maltreat:--handle shamefully.

G809.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἔχω (in the sense of its congener σχῆμα); properly, shapeless, i.e. (figuratively) inelegant:--uncomely.

G940.d: akin to φάσκω; to malign, i.e. (by extension) to fascinate (by false representations):--bewitch.

G904.d: of Hebrew origin (בָּלָק); Balak, a Moabite:--Balac.

G764.d: from ἀσεβής; to be (by implied act) impious or wicked:--commit (live, that after should live) ungodly.

G798.d: neuter from ἀστήρ; properly, a constellation; put for a single star (natural or artificial):--star.

G754.d: from ἀρχή and τελώνης; a principle tax-gatherer:--chief among the publicans.

G595.d: from ἀποτίθημι; a laying aside (literally or figuratively):--putting away (off).

G523.d: from ἀπό and αἰτέω; to demand back:--ask again, require.

G730.d: probably from αἴρω; male (as stronger for lifting):--male, man.

G795.d: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and (an aim); to miss the mark, i.e. (figuratively) deviate from truth:--err, swerve.

G618.d: from ἀπό and λαμβάνω; to receive (specially, in full, or as a host); also to take aside:--receive, take.

G874.d: from a compound of ἀπό and ὁρμάω; a starting-point, i.e. (figuratively) an opportunity:--occasion.

G549.d: from ἀπό and (to go); to go away:--go. Compare ἄπειμι.

G591.d: from ἀπό and δίδωμι; to give away, i.e. up, over, back, etc. (in various applications):--deliver (again), give (again), (re-)pay(-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield.

G569.d: from ἄπιστος; to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey:--believe not.

G807.d: from ἀσχήμων; to be (i.e. act) unbecoming:--behave self uncomely (unseemly).

G697.d: from (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of πήγνυμι; rock of Ares, a place in Athens:--Areopagus, Mars' Hill.

G956.d: from βάλλω; a missile, i.e. spear or arrow:--dart.

G692.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἔργον; inactive, i.e. unemployed; (by implication) lazy, useless:--barren, idle, slow.

G786.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σπένδω; literally, without libation (which usually accompanied a treaty), i.e. (by implication) truceless:--implacable, truce-breaker.

G726.d: from a derivative of αἱρέομαι; to seize (in various applications):--catch (away, up), pluck, pull, take (by force).

G882.d: of uncertain derivation; Achaia (i.e. Greece), a country of Europe:--Achaia.

G985.d: from (a sprout); to germinate; by implication, to yield fruit:--bring forth, bud, spring (up).

G581.d: past participle of a compound of ἀπό and γίνομαι; absent, i.e. deceased (figuratively, renounced):--being dead.

G525.d: from ἀπό and ἀλλάσσω; to change away, i.e. release, (reflexively) remove:--deliver, depart.

G563.d: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of περισπάω; undistractedly, i.e. free from (domestic) solicitude:--without distraction.

G558.d: from ἀπό and ἐλεύθερος; one freed away, i.e. a freedman:--freeman.

G524.d: from ἀπό and (to smart); to grieve out, i.e. become apathetic:--be past feeling.

G962.d: of Hebrew origin (בַּיִת and עֲבָרָה); ferry-house; Bethabara (i.e. Bethabarah), a place on the Jordan:--Bethabara.

G604.d: from ἀπό and καταλλάσσω; to reconcile fully:--reconcile.

G839.d: from a derivative of the same as ἀήρ (meaning a breeze, i.e. the morning air); properly, fresh, i.e. (adverb with ellipsis of ἡμέρα) to-morrow:--(to-)morrow, next day.

G652.d: from ἀποστέλλω; a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers):--apostle, messenger, he that is sent.

G852.d: from Α (as a negative particle) and φαίνω; non-apparent:--that is not manifest.

G805.d: from ἀσφαλής; to render secure:--make fast (sure).

G968.d: from the base of βάσις; a step, i.e. foot-breath; by implication, a rostrum, i.e. a tribunal:--judgment-seat, set (foot) on, throne.

G635.d: from ἀπό and πλανάω; to lead astray (figuratively); passively, to stray (from truth):--err, seduce.

G973.d: from βιάζω; a forcer, i.e. (figuratively) energetic:--violent.

G667.d: from ἀπό and φέρω; to bear off (literally or relatively):--bring, carry (away).

G906.d: a primary verb; to throw (in various applications, more or less violent or intense):--arise, cast (out), X dung, lay, lie, pour, put (up), send, strike, throw (down), thrust. Compare ῥίπτω.

G522.d: from ἀπό and αἴρω; to lift off, i.e. remove:--take (away).

G986.d: perhaps the same as the base of βλαστάνω; Blastus, an officer of Herod Agrippa:--Blastus.

G869.d: adverb from ἀφανής (contraction); unawares, i.e. unexpectedly:--suddenly.

G844.d: from αὐτός and the same as μάτην; self-moved ("automatic"), i.e. spontaneous:--of own accord, of self.

G854.d: from ἀφανίζω; disappearance, i.e. (figuratively) abrogation:--vanish away.

G687.d: a form of ἄρα, denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed:--therefore.
